About.ADropInReplacementFor: A drop-in replacement for the XAMPP Control Panel on Windows: the same layout, with clean MySQL shutdowns, readable errors, PHP and MariaDB versions, HTTPS local sites, Xdebug, Mailpit and a port conflict fixer.
About.BuiltWithAvaloniaAndNET: Built with Avalonia and .NET. Unofficial, not affiliated with Apache Friends. XAMPP is a trademark of Apache Friends; Apache, MariaDB, MySQL, PHP, Xdebug and Mailpit belong to their respective owners.
